scope: Proposition 8.1 (Scalar jet bound) of the manuscript “Log abundance in characteristic zero” (preprints/Log-abundance-in-characteristic-zero-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 87b191f75e8c8526), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 53-54. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For sufficiently small t, let P be the positive part of 2r(K+2tA), and put ρ = (Pn)1/n. At a very general point, every nonzero section of every Cartier multiple kP 53 has order at most 4kρ. The same statement holds on a common resolution after adding an effective exceptional divisor that does not change the section spaces. Moreover 2rµt ≤ ρ ≤ 4rµt, so in particular ρ ≤ 8ϵ for small t.
